stemMd: What is the midpoint of the segment joining (−4, 7) and (6, −1)?
explanationMd: Average corresponding coordinates: horizontal coordinate (−4 + 6)/2 = 1 and vertical coordinate (7 − 1)/2 = 3. The midpoint must lie halfway along both coordinate changes, giving (1,3).

distractorRationale.c: This adds coordinates but fails to divide by two.
distractorRationale.e: This uses half the coordinate differences rather than their averages.
distractorRationale.d: This makes a sign error in the horizontal average.
distractorRationale.b: This does not average seven and negative one correctly.
